description_en: Creates an asynchronous export task for the consumption details of a single consumer or consumer group under a gateway quota rule
description_zh: 为网关配额规则下的单个消费者或消费者组创建消费明细异步导出任务
name: CreateGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway. Required. Specifies the gateway for which you want to export consumption details
parameters.help_zh: 网关 ID。必填。指定需要导出消费明细的网关
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the quota rule. Required. The rule must belong to the gateway specified by gatewayId
parameters.help_zh: 配额规则 ID。必填。规则必须属于 gatewayId 指定的网关
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumption subject. Required. Pass the consumer ID (with the cs- prefix) for consumer rules, and the consumer group ID (with the csg- prefix) for consumer group rules. When you create a task, the subject must be bound to the specified rule, and the subject type must match the rule
parameters.help_zh: 消费主体 ID。必填。消费者规则传入消费者 ID（cs- 前缀），消费者组规则传入消费者组 ID（csg- 前缀）。创建任务时，主体必须已绑定到指定规则，且主体类型与规则一致
parameters.name: subject_id

parameters.help_en:
An optional token used for request idempotency. The maximum length is 128 bytes after removing leading and trailing whitespace. Use ASCII characters.

When the same user retries with the same token and request parameters in the current region, the existing task is reused and its current status is returned. If the same token corresponds to different parameters, a parameter error is returned. The compared parameters include gatewayId, ruleId, subjectId, filterFailedRequests, format, and whether startTime and endTime are passed and their values. Omitting the time is not equivalent to explicitly passing 0.

Reusing a task does not recalculate the time range or regenerate the file. When you need to re-export data (including when the original task fails or the file expires), use a new token
parameters.help_zh:
用于请求幂等的可选令牌。去除首尾空白后最多 128 字节，建议使用 ASCII 字符。

同一用户在当前地域使用相同令牌和相同请求参数重试时，复用已有任务并返回其当前状态；相同令牌对应不同参数时返回参数错误。比较参数包括 gatewayId、ruleId、subjectId、filterFailedRequests、format，以及 startTime 和 endTime 是否传入及其值。省略时间与显式传入 0 不等价。

复用任务不会重新计算时间范围或重新生成文件。需要重新导出（包括原任务失败或文件过期）时，请使用新的令牌
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the export time range. Use a non-negative UNIX timestamp in seconds. This time is exclusive.

If only endTime is specified, one rule period is deduced forward from this time as the startTime. If neither is specified, the end time is the task creation time. If both are specified, endTime must be greater than or equal to startTime, and the span must not exceed one rule period
parameters.help_zh:
导出时间范围的结束时间，使用非负 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒，不包含该时刻。

仅传 endTime 时，从该时刻向前推导一个规则周期作为 startTime；两者均不传时，结束时间为任务创建时刻。两者均传时，endTime 必须大于或等于 startTime，且跨度不得超过一个规则周期
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to export only consumption details with valid usage. Default value: false.

false: Does not filter records by usage.
true: Filters records with zero usage based on the token or credit metering dimension of the rule, and retains only records with usage
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅导出有有效用量的消费明细。默认值为 false。

false：不按用量过滤记录。
true：按规则的 token 或 credit 计量维度，过滤用量为0的记录，仅保留有用量的记录
parameters.name: filter_failed_requests

parameters.help_en: The format of the exported file. Only CSV_GZIP is supported. If omitted or an empty string is passed, this format is used by default. The file is a GZIP-compressed CSV file named `{taskId}.csv.gz` and must be decompressed before reading
parameters.help_zh: 导出文件格式。目前仅支持 CSV_GZIP，省略或传空字符串时默认使用该格式。文件为经过 GZIP 压缩的 CSV，文件名为 `{taskId}.csv.gz`，需解压后读取
parameters.name: format

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the export time range. Use a non-negative UNIX timestamp in seconds. This time is inclusive.

If neither startTime nor endTime is specified: The start point of the current rule period to the task creation time is used.
If only startTime is specified: One rule period is deduced backward from this time as the endTime.
If both are specified: endTime must be greater than or equal to startTime, and the span must not exceed one rule period.

The actual export start point is also limited by the rule creation time, rule reset, or the effective start point of clearing history records. You can confirm this by querying the effectiveWindowStart returned by the task
parameters.help_zh:
导出时间范围的开始时间，使用非负 Unix 时间戳，单位为秒，包含该时刻。

与 endTime 均不传：使用当前规则周期的起点至任务创建时刻。
仅传 startTime：从该时刻向后推导一个规则周期作为 endTime。
两者均传：endTime 必须大于或等于 startTime，跨度不得超过一个规则周期。

实际导出起点还受规则创建时间、规则重置或清除历史记录的生效起点限制；可通过查询任务返回的 effectiveWindowStart 确认
parameters.name: start_time

status.description_en:
The current status of create task. Valid values:

Pending: Create task is submitted and waiting to be processed.
Running: The system is querying details, generating files, or uploading files.
Success: The export is successful. Call the query operation to obtain the file information.
Failed: The export fails. Call the query operation to view the errorMessage.

A newly created task returns Pending. When an existing task is reused through clientToken, the status of create task at that time is returned, which is not guaranteed to be Pending
status.description_zh:
任务当前状态。

Pending：任务已提交，等待处理。
Running：正在查询明细、生成文件或上传文件。
Success：导出成功。请调用查询接口获取文件信息。
Failed：导出失败。请调用查询接口查看 errorMessage。

新建任务返回 Pending；通过 clientToken 复用已有任务时，返回该任务当时的状态，不保证为 Pending

taskId.description_en: The ID of the export task. When you call GetGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask, pass this value along with the gatewayId, ruleId, and subjectId from this request
taskId.description_zh: 导出任务 ID。调用 GetGatewayQuotaRuleSubjectUsageExportTask 时，将此值与本次请求中的 gatewayId、ruleId、subjectId 一起传入

requestId.description_en: The request ID of this OpenAPI call, which is used to troubleshoot call issues. This is different from the request_id of each consumption record in the exported file
requestId.description_zh: 本次 OpenAPI 调用的请求 ID，用于排查调用问题。与导出文件中每条消费记录的 request_id 不同

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The optional configurations for the export task. If omitted, the task exports data for the current rule period, does not filter records with zero usage, and uses the CSV_GZIP format
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 导出任务的可选配置。省略时按当前规则周期导出，不过滤零用量记录，使用 CSV_GZIP 格式
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The optional configurations for the export task. If omitted, the task exports data for the current rule period, does not filter records with zero usage, and uses the CSV_GZIP format
v1_parameters.help_zh: 导出任务的可选配置。省略时按当前规则周期导出，不过滤零用量记录，使用 CSV_GZIP 格式
v1_parameters.name: body

When you create a task, the subject must be bound to the specified rule, and the subject type must match the rule
v1_parameters.help_zh: 消费主体 ID。必填。消费者规则传入消费者 ID（cs- 前缀），消费者组规则传入消费者组 ID（csg- 前缀）。创建任务时，主体必须已绑定到指定规则，且主体类型与规则一致
